post.text:
mlx-audio v0.4.2 is out 🔊

New Models
→ Irodori-TTS (Japanese TTS)
→ HumeAI TADA by @hume_ai 
→ KugelAudio TTS
→ Cohere Transcribe ASR by @cohere 
→ Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603 by @MistralAI 
→ Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct by @Alibaba_Qwen 
→ Moshi STS by @kyutai_labs 

What’s New
→ Voxtral TTS streaming with overlap-add decoding
→ Distil-Whisper added to supported models list
→ Trendshift badge on README

Fixes
→ Qwen3-TTS streaming memory leak
→ Parakeet streaming defaults & NeMo preprocessing
→ Quantized model loading for Fish Qwen3 Omni
→ NumPy → mx.array in realtime STT streaming
→ Quantization metadata preserved in VoiceVoice sanitize
→ Streamed generation now saves audio to disk
→ Removed PyTorch dep from Cohere ASR buffer loading
→ Whisper timestamps fix

Big thanks to our contributors 🙏
@yoshphys @korale77 @sudabg @hewliyang @mvdirty @n0madic @isshintian_cohere @chazmaniandinkle @mm65x @orbitalquark @andimarafioti @beshkenadze @KarnikShreyas @lllucas 

Get started today:

> uv pip install -U mlx-audio

Leave us a star ⭐️ https://t.co/hj007yMMH8
